## ⚡ Improved

- **A warning for an http office URL.** When OpenCloud runs on https and **Office document server URL** starts with `http://`, browsers block the editor and documents open blank without any error. The log now says so at startup and names the https address to use instead.
- The **Web office suite** and **Office document server URL** fields sit in the template's normal view instead of under Advanced View, next to the WOPI secret.
- README: the web office section asks for the https URL and points to the [Euro Office](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/euro-office) template, which serves https out of the box from its 1.1.0 on.
- README: a new troubleshooting entry for a log that ends with `unable to publish event` and `fatal error - exiting`. It means the internal message bus stopped answering, and the entry shows how to check whether the Data folder sits in RAM or on a disk that hangs.
